scenarios.label: Normal river level
scenarios.disclaimer: Indicative scenario from a 30 m elevation model (Copernicus GLO-30, height above mapped rivers and lakes), not a forecast. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance. Only the area 101.46–101.56 E, 3.15–3.24 N is assessed; paths outside it are not.
